description: Defines the AddressSorterPosix class for sorting IP addresses based on policies, including nested structures for policy entries and source address info, and implements IP address change notifications.

classes.name: AddressSorterPosix
classes.description: Implements address sorting based on explicit policies, not thread-safe, and observes network address changes.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of IP endpoints asynchronously using specified callback.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when the IP address changes.

methods.name: FillPolicy
methods.description: Populates address info based on policy tables.

methods.name: FinishedSort
methods.description: Completes the sorting process for a given context.
